title: Sync request
description: Batch of table status events sent to POST /v1/sync. The server is idempotent on (device_id, seq); a gap yields 409 with expected_seq.

seq.description: Monotonic per device. The ceiling is the signed 64-bit range used by SQLite INTEGER.

events.description: At most 100 events or 64 KB per request. The byte limit is enforced by the server, not by JSON Schema.
